title: Silent Terror
stack: Angular · Python / FastAPI · MySQL · Docker · SVM · Fuzzy Logic · Ollama
description: Exploring hybrid conversational AI for a social-deduction game, combining intent classification, fuzzy reasoning, and LLM dialogue.
role: Team Lead · Full-stack Developer · AI Researcher

ai.approach: SVM identifies chat intent; fuzzy logic estimates suspicion; Qwen3 uses these signals and role context to generate dialogue. Experiments cover local CPU/GPU inference and an OpenAI API option.
ai.output: NOX bot dialogue informed by chat intent, suspicion scores, and game context.
ai.evaluation: Ongoing research prototype with pipeline tracing. Game actions use rules; the fuzzy silence input is currently fixed.

title: AI Trainer
stack: Python · TensorFlow / Keras · MediaPipe Pose · FastAPI · React
description: Exploring exercise-quality assessment from body poses, using autoencoder reconstruction error to detect deviations from correct movement patterns.

ai.focus: Computer Vision · Deep Learning · Anomaly Detection
ai.approach: Summarize joint angles by mean, standard deviation, minimum, maximum, and range. Train a separate TensorFlow/Keras autoencoder for each exercise on correct movements; higher reconstruction error indicates greater deviation. The report uses MediaPipe Pose; the API accepts MoveNet-style keypoints.
ai.output: Exercise-quality scores for push-ups, pull-ups, squats, and planks, derived from reconstruction error.
ai.evaluation: Reported reconstruction MSE: approximately 0.03–0.05, with more stable training for push-up and plank. Viewpoint, data diversity, and scoring thresholds remain limitations. The frontend demo is not yet connected to the AI scoring API.

title: Mushroom Vision
stack: React · Python / Flask · TensorFlow / Keras · OpenCV · scikit-learn
description: Exploring mushroom image classification with handcrafted visual features and a convolutional neural network.

ai.approach: Resize to 128 x 128, extract HSV, GLCM, Hu moments, HOG, LBP, and FAST features, then scale the feature vector for CNN inference. The model learns from these features rather than raw pixels.
ai.output: Predicted mushroom class, per-image confidence score, and descriptive metadata.
ai.evaluation: Multiple experiment iterations; no benchmark reported in the README. Per-image confidence is not overall accuracy.

title: Diebety AI Predict
description: Exploring diabetes-risk prediction from tabular data, with interpretable machine learning and SHAP feature analysis.

ai.approach: Preprocess tabular data and explore Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost. Use SHAP to examine how input features contribute to predictions.
ai.output: Diabetes-risk predictions from user inputs, delivered through a Streamlit demo.
ai.evaluation: Approximately 90% accuracy reported in the project profile; the evaluation split and per-model scores are not documented there.

title: SkolioCheck
description: Exploring VGG16-based deep learning for scoliosis classification from X-ray images.

ai.focus: Computer Vision · Deep Learning · Medical Imaging
ai.approach: Convert X-rays to RGB, resize to 224 x 224, and normalize pixels to 0-1. Run VGG16-based CNN inference and apply a 0.6 classification threshold.
ai.output: An X-ray classification result: Normal Detected or Scoliosis Detected.
ai.evaluation: Research prototype; verified accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity are not available in the reviewed documentation.
